basic_details.job_title: Pub Kamrup College Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Pub Kamrup College, Baihata Chariali, Kamrup, Assam, is inviting applications for the post of Principal. Applications must be in the prescribed format of DHE, Assam and must go through proper channel. Each application must include a non-refundable demand draft of Rs.5000/-. The application must reach the President, Governing Body, Pub Kamrup College, Baihata Chariali-781381 within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement appeared in The Assam Tribune, Guwahati, on 15 November 2026, so the deadline is about 30 November 2026 (15 days from 15 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: About Pub Kamrup College
content_sections.text: Pub Kamrup College is a college at Baihata Chariali in Kamrup district, Assam (P.O.- Baihata Chariali, PIN 781381). The notice comes from the Office of the President of the college. It is signed by Dr. Alaka Das, President, Governing Body, Pub Kamrup College. The recruitment is made in response to a letter from the Director of Higher Education, Assam. It also follows the Government of Assam OM no. AHE.45/2019/2 dated 25/02/2019.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach the undersigned, the President, Governing Body of the college. The notice prints this address: President, Governing Body, Pub Kamrup College, Baihata Chariali-781381 The letterhead of the issuing office reads: Office of the President, Pub-Kamrup College, P.O.- Baihata Chariali, Dist.- Kamrup (Assam), PIN- 781381.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for the post of Principal, Pub Kamrup College. It does not print the pay. Master's Degree with at least 55 percent marks, or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed, by a recognized university. Ph.D degree in concerned/ allied/ relevant discipline(s). Professor/Associate Professor with at least 15 years of teaching/ research experience in University/ College and other Institution of Higher Education. A minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals. A minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II of Table 2 of UGC Regulation 2018. A relaxation of 5% marks may be provided at Master's Degree level for SC/ST/PWD candidates. The eligibility marks of 55% are permissible only on the qualifying marks, without any grace marks. This also applies to an equivalent grade in a point scale where grading system is followed. The 5% relaxation for these categories follows the same rule. The upper age limit of the candidate is 55 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format of DHE, Assam. All self-attested testimonials from HSLC onwards. A non-refundable demand draft of Rs.5000/- in favour of Principal, Pub Kamrup College, payable at Punjab National Bank, Baihata Chariali Branch.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has Pub Kamrup College advertised?
faq.answer: Pub Kamrup College, Baihata Chariali, Kamrup, Assam has invited applications for the post of Principal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Pub Kamrup College Principal post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the college within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement appeared in The Assam Tribune on 15 November 2026, so the deadline is about 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree with at least 55 percent marks and a Ph.D in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline(s). They also need at least 15 years as Professor/Associate Professor in teaching/research. The other requirements are a minimum of 10 research publications and a research score of 110 as per UGC Regulation 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Pub Kamrup College Principal post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit of the candidate is 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is a non-refundable demand draft of Rs.5000/-. It must be drawn in favour of Principal, Pub Kamrup College, payable at Punjab National Bank, Baihata Chariali Branch.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed format of DHE, Assam and attach self-attested testimonials from HSLC onwards and the demand draft. Send it through proper channel so that it reaches the President, Governing Body, Pub Kamrup College, Baihata Chariali-781381 within 15 days of publication.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of the Principal post?
faq.answer: The tenure of the post of Principal shall be 5 years.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any relaxation in marks for reserved categories?
faq.answer: A relaxation of 5% marks may be provided at Master's Degree level for SC/ST/PWD candidates. It applies only on the qualifying marks, without any grace marks.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid to candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is permissible.

faq.question: Q10. How should a working Principal apply?
faq.answer: Working Principals must apply through proper channel.
